# t9.1 — Plan-to-tasks remediation

## Status

**Remediation applied; the plan-to-tasks gate has not been rerun.** This artifact records plan edits and structural checks only; it is not a gate verdict.

## Summary

Updated the native Android implementation plan and its trace checkpoint to address all findings in t9:

- Corrected REQ-021–REQ-026 mappings to match the numbered Health Connect/BLE steps and upstream spec-to-plan checkpoint.
- Added legacy `[Source:]` references to the navigation, persistence-boundary, and shared-domain conversion tasks T003–T005.
- Changed T001 to record toolchain readiness only; moved wrapper creation and the first meaningful build attempt to T002. A blocked toolchain result no longer prevents scaffold or source tasks; native build/device gates remain blocked until verified.
- Bounded T004 to shared encrypted database/key/backup/migration infrastructure and moved feature-owned entities, DAOs, migrations, and transaction tests into their vertical slices.
- Corrected task story labels to the t1 user-story IDs, including the two existing recipe/ingredient stories and new Health Connect/BLE stories.
- Refreshed plan-item-to-task checkpoint links for feature-owned persistence and recipe-deletion integration. Marked the checkpoint as pending an independent gate rerun instead of carrying forward its obsolete `passed: true`.

The plan still has 18 implementation items, 19 sequential tasks, and 26 requirement rows. This planning task does not implement the Android app and makes no Android build/runtime claim.
